Assembly & Design, Inc. operates as a family-owned contract electronics manufacturer in the Richmond, Virginia area, with its physical address in N Chesterfield. The firm provides complete electronic assembly and testing services for customers seeking contract manufacturing support. The company has not published a stated mission or differentiation narrative beyond its long-standing family ownership and comprehensive assembly and testing offering. Its website presents a straightforward service description without promotional claims about quality systems or unique capabilities.
